title: Full Moon in Taurus
tldr: A culmination and release point for the Taurus / Scorpio axis.
theme: This Full Moon illuminates value, steadiness, embodiment, money, and what is worth protecting through the Taurus side of the axis, while the Sun in Scorpio asks for integration rather than extremes.
shadow: staying in stale situations because they are comfortable, or mistaking possession for security
integration: building stability that can hold change instead of resisting it

twoWeekArc.teaching: This arc shows where holding on too tightly pushes away what you want.
twoWeekArc.appPrompt: Name what the last two weeks revealed. Release the pattern that blocks the Taurus / Scorpio balance point.

sixMonthArc.appPrompt: Look back to the same-sign New Moon. What took root because you tended it, and what grew because the soil was left untended?

ritual.function: illumination, release, cleansing, integration, and completion
ritual.timing: Use after the exact Full Moon when possible. Keep eclipse lunations under the separate witness protocol, not ordinary release ritual.
ritual.materials: Venus kamea, green or white candle, rose quartz, copper, peridot, roses, water, and incense.
ritual.simpleSubstitution: A white candle, water, paper, and a quiet place are enough.
ritual.action: Write what is complete, what is ready to be released, and how the higher expression of Taurus can be embodied without rejecting Scorpio.

journalPrompt: What am I ready to release from the shadow of Taurus, and what balance with Scorpio is asking to be lived now?
tarotPrompt: What truth is this Taurus Full Moon revealing that I can no longer avoid?
